name: Review Pagination
summary: Review-result profile of canonical Pagination with a specific navigation name, target-supplied finite page items, and target-owned provider and result lifecycle.

anatomy.name: rootProfile
anatomy.description: Review-context hook layered on the required canonical Pagination navigation root; it adds no independent visual or keyboard behavior.

anatomy.name: list
anatomy.description: Required canonical Pagination native list preserving destination order and grouping.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Repeated canonical Pagination list item containing exactly one destination, current page, or ellipsis.

anatomy.name: link
anatomy.description: Canonical Link destination for an available page, previous page, or next page.

anatomy.name: current
anatomy.description: Exactly one canonical non-interactive current-page indicator when the component renders.

anatomy.name: ellipsis
anatomy.description: Optional canonical passive skipped-range marker hidden from assistive technology.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Localized accessible name that identifies this navigation as review pagination.

properties.name: currentPage
properties.description: Positive target projection matching the one rendered canonical current item; it does not define total pages or a page-window algorithm.

properties.name: pageItems
properties.description: Finite target-supplied canonical Pagination list containing previous, page, current, ellipsis, and next items with real destination URLs.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Canonical Pagination touch-friendly size and intrinsic wrapping.

states.name: default
states.description: Named review navigation using canonical Pagination presentation.

behavior.name: paginationComposition
behavior.description: Review Pagination consumes canonical Pagination structure, Link destinations, current-page treatment, ellipses, boundary omission, wrapping, RTL, forced-colors, reduced-motion, and zero-runtime behavior without recreating them.

behavior.name: navigationLandmark
behavior.description: The profile remains a specifically named native navigation landmark that distinguishes review pages from other navigation regions.

behavior.name: nativeLinks
behavior.description: Every available destination is a canonical native Link with a real target-owned URL and ordinary Tab, Enter, browser-history, and modified-activation behavior.

behavior.name: currentPage
behavior.description: Exactly one non-interactive canonical item represents the current page; it is not a button, self-link, or disabled pseudo-control.

behavior.name: boundaryOmission
behavior.description: Previous is omitted on the first page and next is omitted on the last page instead of leaving dead disabled focus stops.

behavior.name: ellipsis
behavior.description: Every ellipsis is passive, hidden from assistive technology, and never rendered as a link or button.

behavior.name: targetOwnedLifecycle
behavior.description: The provider or target owns total pages, page-window calculation, URLs or cursor translation, requests, loading/errors, result replacement, history, scroll, focus, announcements, analytics and prefetch.

behavior.name: contentResilience
behavior.description: The finite supplied item window wraps inside its actual container without review-specific scrolling, CSS hiding, reordering, or viewport assumptions.

accessibility: Render a specifically named native navigation landmark containing the canonical Pagination list.
Use native canonical Links with href for every available destination and preserve normal Tab and Enter behavior.
Mark exactly one non-interactive current item with aria-current="page".
Omit unavailable previous or next destinations instead of leaving disabled controls in sequential focus.
Hide passive ellipsis items from assistive technology and never make them interactive.
Give icon-only previous and next Links localized accessible names and hide decorative icons.
Leave review loading, result announcements, focus restoration, scrolling, pending/error state, history, URL synchronization and provider behavior to one target coordinator.

web.notes: The review root profile consumes canonical Pagination and Link markup, presentation and behavior; it adds no visual token or neutral runtime.

shopify.notes: A selected review-provider app block may map its finite page model to canonical Pagination; no provider-neutral review Liquid is authorized.
